name: Vidar
subtitle: Silent Avenger
description: Grows stronger as allies are defeated and avenges them all.
lore: Prophesied to avenge the death of his father, Odin, and to stand as one of Ragnarok’s few survivors, Vidar is a brooding, silent warrior. He often accompanies other gods into battle as preparation for his grim destiny. Now that the Shattering has thrown this future into question, however, Vidar works to punish all who harm Asgard—especially the gods of Aaru who invaded his Realm.
